entry_conditions: Normal entry: open gripper, TCP high and clear near home, observed red near the initially blue region, and no held object. Intermediate entry is appropriate only when causal geometry clearly matches supervised red acquisition, visibly elevated closed-finger red transport, buffered-red release/retreat, or the red-stable blue-overlap phase. The supplied buffer and relevant poses must be finite, free, and plausibly reachable.
exit_conditions: Core exit: red is visibly settled in the supplied free buffer, fingers are open, and TCP is clear. Overlap-supported later exit: red remains stationary in the buffer while closed fingers are around blue and blue is beginning to lift. The unchanged full-task success rule is not replaced by these handoff cues.
overlap_role: All assigned actions remain supervised through 210-230 overlap actions per demonstration. Buffer-anchored labels cover red lowering, opening, and early retreat; blue-anchored labels cover transit, blue approach/closure, and initial lift. Thus the object near the gripper at early overlap is red being released, while blue is the intended successor object.
successor_readiness: Switch to place_blue after observing stable red containment at the supplied buffer and open, clear fingers/TCP. A later switch after visible blue acquisition and initial lift is also represented. Preserve both causal frames across the switch. Anchor mode, finger closure, and auxiliary phase are not independent grasp or release proof.
failure_signatures: Wrong anchor switching appears as motion toward the buffer before red is visibly elevated, continued red-relative motion after release, or motion toward blue before red is stable. Other signs are red not following a close gripper, red elevated after opening, red entering then leaving the buffer, repeated gripper toggles, or persistent IK nonconvergence/limit contact. No demonstrated recovery supports continuing blindly after these signs.
continuation_guidance: Replan every eight executed controls with fresh observed poses and measured joints. Continue only while the deterministic phase agrees with visible geometry and IK diagnostics remain plausible. If phase/contact is ambiguous, stop or select the validated phase-residual buffer_red__h02 rather than treating h04 as recovery. Terminate this skill on the core exit cue; do not require completion of the optional blue overlap.
limitations: The selected position frame gives phase-local displacement equivariance only. It does not remove reachability, posture, collision, dynamics, object-rotation, contact, occupied-buffer, or perception dependencies. Thresholds can be wrong for drops, misses, unexpectedly elevated objects, noisy poses, or unusual handoffs. Demonstrations are successful and no out-of-distribution or recovery result exists.
